data.title: Mitsubishi Electric Invests in OptQC Startup Developing Optical Quantum Computer Hardware
data.description: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, based in Tokyo and listed as 6503, revealed its investment in OptQC Corp., a Japanese startup specializing in optical quantum computer hardware. This marks the sixteenth investment by the ME Innovation Fund. The shift of quantum computing from theoretical to practical applications has led to increased industrial advancements and a growing need for high-capacity hardware. Industries are now seeking technology that can support the demands of these evolving applications.

data.title: VPG Foil Resistors Partners with Source Technologi to Expand Footprint in India’s Aerospace & Defense, Telecom, and Semiconductor Sectors
data.description: On September 14, 2026, in Bengaluru, India, VPG Foil Resistors, a subsidiary of Vishay Precision Group, Inc. (NYSE:VPG), revealed a significant collaboration with Source Technologi to enhance its market reach in India. The partnership aims to provide precise resistors to vital sectors like Aerospace & Defense, Industrial Automation, Telecom Infrastructure, and Semiconductors.

data.title: IHT RECEIVES NYSE-AMERICAN APPROVAL FOR COMPLIANCE PLAN; REVERSE MERGER DISCUSSIONS CONTINUE
data.description: Phoenix, Arizona - InnSuites Hospitality Trust (NYSE American: IHT) disclosed today that it has been granted an extension by the NYSE American, allowing it to continue its listing despite not meeting continued listing standards. The Compliance Plan submitted on July 24, 2026, has been accepted, and the Trust now has a plan period until December 24, 2027, to regain compliance. This extension provides the trust with the opportunity to address the issues and fulfill the listing requirements.

data.title: Piedmont Realty Trust Announces Pricing of $200,000,000 Exchangeable Senior Notes Offering
data.description: Piedmont Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: PDM) headquartered in Atlanta, GA, disclosed that its Operating Partnership, Piedmont Operating Partnership, LP, has set the pricing for its private offering of 2.875% exchangeable senior notes due 2031 at $200,000,000. The offer was made to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A of the Securities Act of 1933. Piedmont will provide full and unconditional guarantee for the notes on a senior, unsecured basis. The settlement for the issuance and sale of these notes is slated for September 17, 2026, contingent upon standard closing conditions. Additionally, the Operating Partnership has allowed initial purchasers of the notes the option to buy up to an extra $30,000,000 aggregate principal amount of notes within 13 days from the initial issuance date.
